question: Can this single slice establish a 3D void volume fraction?

retrieved.title: A slice measures area, not defect volume
retrieved.terms: 2d area volume ratio percentage slice 二维 面积 体积 占比 百分比 切片

text.en: Single-slice inspection reports pixel counts and area. A volumetric void fraction needs a segmented 3D region and an explicitly defined denominator; neither can be inferred from one slice or a component identifier.
text.zh: 单切片检测报告像素数和面积。空洞体积占比需要三维分割区域及明确的分母，不能由一张切片或一个连通域编号推断。

check.en: Request 3D data and an identified joint region for a joint-level volume fraction. Keep pixel-level evaluation scores separate from defect fractions.
check.zh: 计算单焊点体积占比时，需要三维数据及已识别的焊点区域；评价指标不能当作缺陷占比。

retrieved.title: Slice-wise 3D geometry and measurements
retrieved.terms: 3d volume slice reconstruction dimension depth geometry 体积 三维 切片 深度 重建

text.en: The connected demo reconstructs each parallel-beam detector row independently, then segments the stack and applies 3D reference comparison. It assumes aligned coordinates, isotropic voxels and no mixing between depths. It is not cone-beam CT.
text.zh: 贯通演示对每个平行束探测器行独立重建，再对堆叠体分割并做三维参考比较。它假定坐标对齐、各向同性体素且不同深度之间不混合；当前并非锥束 CT。

check.en: Confirm axis order, spacing and acquisition geometry before applying this workflow to another dataset.
check.zh: 用于其他数据前，确认轴顺序、体素间距和采集几何。

retrieved.title: Measured boundary false positives in the synthetic CT baseline
retrieved.terms: artifact false positive threshold partial volume Hann boundary void artefact 伪影 误报 边界 阈值 空洞

text.en: The archived slice-wise experiment shows boundary misclassification after Hann FBP and fixed thresholding, including missing-solder predictions on clean slices. Candidate differences are not confirmed physical defects.
text.zh: 已归档的逐层实验显示，Hann FBP 与固定阈值分割会导致边界误分，包括在无缺陷层中预测出焊料缺失。候选差异不等于已确认的物理缺陷。

check.en: Inspect grayscale, reference alignment and neighboring slices together; validate any revised segmentation on independent samples.
check.zh: 同时检查灰度图、参考体对齐情况和相邻切片；改进分割后，用独立样本验证。

retrieved.locator: Measured result and CUDA per-signature evaluation
retrieved.scope: Project synthetic baseline; not a general scanner calibration

retrieved.title: QFN/SON voiding: reflow and via design
retrieved.terms: solder void missing solder low density reflow flux 空洞 孔洞 焊料缺失 低密度 回流

text.en: TI describes how reflow flux activity and thermal-via treatment can affect QFN/SON voiding. This is background for a candidate explanation, not proof of the cause in this synthetic sample.
text.zh: TI 指出，回流过程中的助焊剂活性和散热过孔处理会影响 QFN/SON 空洞。这只能提供候选解释，不能证明本合成样本的制造根因。

check.en: If applicable to the actual package, review the paste supplier's reflow profile and via design; compare adjacent slices before confirming a void.
check.zh: 若实际封装适用，检查焊膏供应商的回流曲线和过孔设计，并结合相邻切片复核空洞。

retrieved.scope: QFN/SON assembly guidance; applicability to other package geometries requires review

result.scope: screening differences; no confirmed cause or calibrated confidence
